answer_1.quote: To rewrite the sentences, we employ the state-of-the-art model, which has demonstrated human-level performance in various NLP tasks. By leveraging the GPT-4 model, we eliminate the laborious task of human annotation and enhance the diversity of generation through handcrafted rules.

answer_2.quote: All models perform worse on adversarial examples compared to the original CHEF. Specifically, we highlight the following findings: (1) Chinese DeBERTa drops from 86.69% accuracy on original pairs to 57.84% and 65.01% on adversarial subsets.

answer_4.quote: To control the quality, we invited two Chinese native speakers to annotate randomly sampled 25% of claim-evidence pairs with SUPPORTED, REFUTED or NOT ENOUGH INFO. The results demonstrated strong agreement between humans and GPT-4. They agreed with the dataset labels in 89% of cases, with a Cohen κ of 0.80.
answer_4.guideline: assigning one of two labels, namely SUPPORTS, and REFUTES, while also flagging instances of nongrammatical cases
